arabic text: KIYE HAI SHIMR NE DO QATL EK KHANJAR SE
english translation text: SHIMR COMMITTED TWO MURDERS WITH ONE DAGGER—

arabic text: LAHU HUSSAIN KA POHNCHA BEHEN KI CHADAR SE
english translation text: HUSSAIN’S BLOOD REACHED HIS SISTER’S VEIL.

arabic text: GHAREEB-E-ZAHRA WAHI’N ROTE ROTE MARR JAATA
english translation text: THE ORPHAN OF ZAHRA (HUSSAIN) WOULD HAVE DIED WEEPING RIGHT THERE,

arabic text: BEHEN UTHA KE NA LAATI JO LAASH-E-AKBAR SE
english translation text: IF HIS SISTER HAD NOT BROUGHT HIM AWAY FROM AKBAR’S BODY.

arabic text: KISI NE BAALON SE PAKRA KOI UTHA KE CHALA,
english translation text: ONE HELD HIM BY THE HAIR, ANOTHER DRAGGED HIM ALONG,

arabic text: SAR-E-HUSSAIN KO MAARA KISI NE PATTHAR SE
english translation text: AND SOMEONE STRUCK HUSSAIN’S HEAD WITH A STONE.

arabic text: USE UTHAYA HAI BABA KI LAASH SE AISE,
english translation text: SHE (SAKINA) WAS LIFTED FROM HER FATHER’S BODY IN SUCH A WAY,

arabic text: KE PHIR SAKINA NAHI SOYI SHIMR KE DARR SE
english translation text: THAT AFTER THAT, SAKINA NEVER SLEPT AGAIN—OUT OF FEAR OF SHIMR.

arabic text: LAB-E-HUSSAIN (AS) PE HASS HASS KE MARTA HAI CHARRI,
english translation text: HE KEPT STRIKING HUSSAIN’S LIPS WITH MOCKING LAUGHTER,

arabic text: YAZEED KHEL RAHA THA HUSSAIN (AS) KE SARR SE
english translation text: YAZID WAS PLAYING WITH HUSSAIN’S BLESSED HEAD.

arabic text: BULAYA SHAAM KE ZINDAN MEIN JAB SAKINA NE,
english translation text: WHEN SAKINA CALLED OUT FROM THE PRISON OF SHAAM,

arabic text: HUSSAIN PYAASE PALAT AAYE HAUZE KAUSAR SE
english translation text: HUSSAIN RETURNED THIRSTY FROM THE POOL OF KAUSAR.

arabic text: FAQAT GALA HI NAHI SHAH KA KATA RAN MEIN
english translation text: IT WAS NOT JUST THE IMAM’S NECK THAT WAS CUT IN THE BATTLEFIELD,

arabic text: KATE HAI HAATH BHI ZAHRA (SA) KE KUND KHANJAR SE
english translation text: EVEN THE HANDS OF ZAHRA WERE CUT BY THAT CURSED DAGGER.

arabic text: BEHEN KA PARDA TAQALLUM USE BANA NA THA,
english translation text: HE NEEDED TO MAKE HIS SISTER’S VEIL OF MODESTY,

arabic text: SUNA RAHA THA WOH QURAN SEENA KE MIMBAR SE
english translation text: HE WAS RECITING THE QUR’AN FROM THE TOP OF THE SPEAR.
